text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Oh, today's the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text:
What should we do? Should we go
watch? I'm
okay either way.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I think I've had enough of races.
Anyway, did you
see Curren Chan's
Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I did! Yukino was in some of the pictures!
She
looked so awkward, though. Is she
still a kid or
what?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey-doke...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: The Shuka Sho's fin'lly here!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run as fast as my legs'll take
me and
shine brighter'n anyone!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I can do that, the people who've lost
int'rest in
me should get back on board...

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the crowd looks a bit different
today. Usually,
Yukino Bijin's fans stick
out like sore thumbs.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Guess this means things
have finally gotten
back to normal
around here.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You gotta wonder why though... Yukino
was incredible
at the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Who cares?! I'm a Harp Alpha fan, and
it's time for her
to win!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gee...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So who am I s'posed to be runn'n for?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere at today's race differs
slightly
from her previous races. It may
be slight, but it's
enough to throw
Yukino Bijin off her game.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What am I s'posed to do, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No one in the crowd wants t'see me win,
so what's
even the point...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Maybe, but... I was hop'n I could... y'know, change things today.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait a second, what 'xactly am I
try'n to
change?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I think I'm going cuckoo!

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Yukino Bijin! It's almost time
to start getting
ready!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aaah, I gotta go!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-right! Off I go then!
